text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The world of Geo-Gehenna, where suffocating humidity and scorching lava heat reign supreme.
In this land of survival of the fittest, ruled by the strongest of the strong, a game among the powerful was about to begin.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──湿気と溶岩の熱に晒された世界『ジオ・ゲヘナ』。
絶対的な強者が平定する、
弱肉強食の国で
まさに今、
強者たちによる『遊戯』が始まろうとしていた。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Otherwordly guest who hails from distant lands, Lady Ai.
Until the sun hides itself behind the veil of night, you must flee on those slender feet...
Lest you fall prey to the fierce, fanged creatures that now lie in wait.
text_block_list.orig_text:
遥かな異界より来たりし客人、
アイ殿や。
牙を研ぐ猛き化生と鬼事を──
お天道様が夜の帳へ隠るるまで、
その細足で
逃げおおせなんし。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Should you succeed, I shall grant your wish.
I eagerly await the spectacle♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
見事果たし候うた暁には
其の望み、
叶えて差し上げんしょう。
楽しみでありんす喃♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Umm. So, I just have to play tag with those people and avoid getting caught until nightfall to win...
Is that right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………えっと。
あの人たちと鬼ごっこをして
わたしが夜まで逃げ切れたら勝ち、
で
あっている……？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Yup, that's right.
And if you win, she'll grant any request you might have!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あってるあってる。
しかも
勝ったらアイのお願い、
なんでも聞いてくれるって！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
But apparently, these guys are among the fastest of Nephy Nella's subordinates!
And in this scorching heat, no less.
I'm sure you'll be fine, but... here, I've made you a water orb. Go ahead and equip it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもこいつら、
ネフィ＝ネラの部下の中でも
かなりの俊足らしいわよ？
しかもこの炎天下でしょ？　
あんたなら心配ないとは思うけど
……
とりあえず、
水のボール作ったから装備しておきなさい？

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
So you can even do things like this with magic!
Thanks, I'll put it to good use.
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔法って
こんなこともできるのね！
ありがとう、
使わせてもらうわ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Hey you guys. You sure are lucky... being the "chasers".
If things were the other way around, this contest would be over in no time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたたち、
よかったわね。
『追いかける側』で。
逆ならすぐ勝負がついちゃうんだから。

text_block_list.name: Monstresses 1
text_block_list.text:
Hah. I wonder if that bravado will last until nightfall...
Poor little thing. You really drew the short straw, picking a fight with us without even knowing who we are.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハッ。
夜までその強気が残ってりゃいいけど……
……
お嬢ちゃん、
運がなかったわねぇ。
アタシたちのことも知らないで、
ケンカを売っちゃうなんて。

text_block_list.name: Monstresses 2
text_block_list.text:
Playing tag, what a drag...
Well, I've got a special move, anyway.
Might as well just end this in a flash.
text_block_list.orig_text:
鬼ごっことか、
ダルすぎ……
ま、
こっちは必殺技があるし。
秒で終わらせればいっか。

text_block_list.name: Monstresses 3
text_block_list.text:
I'll drench you in muddy water and give you a proper Gehenna-style welcome!
Heh heh. Even when I catch you, I'll let you escape on purpose, just so I can count how many times I've "hunted" you down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
泥水ブチ込んで、
ゲヘナ流の歓迎をしてやる！
へへっ、
追いついてもわざと逃がして、
狩った回数を数えてやるよ！

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Good! Then let's get started and...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ！
それじゃ早速──

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Begin the race!
text_block_list.orig_text: 勝負よっ！

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: …………………… (Excited)

text_block_list.name: Monstresses 3
text_block_list.text: *pant pant*... I can't keep up...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぜぇ、
はぁ、
ぜぇ……
追いつけねぇ……！

text_block_list.name: 妖魔人２
text_block_list.text:
……ってか、
速すぎ。
くそだる……
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ってか、
速すぎ。
くそだる……

text_block_list.name: Monstresses 3
text_block_list.text:
Not a single one of my "water crusher" shots is landing, she's dodging them all with these bizarre dance-like steps...
I'm beat.
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺の『水鉄砲』が一発も当たンねぇし、
妙なステップで全部躱してきやがるし……
もうお手上げだ。

text_block_list.name: Monstresses 2
text_block_list.text:
I could turn her to stone in seconds with my ultimate "Petrifying Breath"...
But she's so light on her feet that I can't even land a hit with it...
Can we just surrender?
text_block_list.orig_text:
必殺の石化ブレスで固めてやれば秒だけどさ……
フットワーク軽すぎて、
そもそもブレス当たらないんですけど……
降参してい？

text_block_list.name: Monstresses 1
text_block_list.text:
...And what do you think is going to happen next if we just give up?
Think back! Remember how things have played out so far...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………降参したら、
次は何が始まると思ってんのよ。
思
い出しなさいよ！　
今までの流れを……！！

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're surrendering?
Then that means I win! But there's still plenty of time until nightfall...
Would you like another round?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
降参ですか？　
じゃあ、
わたしの勝ちですね！
でも
夜まで時間ありますし……
もう一度、
勝負しませんか！？

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hah... You're giving up?
Then I win again! You were all even faster than before!
Um... Would you like to try one more time?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふー……
降参ですか？　
それなら、
またわたしの勝ちですね！
みなさん、
さっきよりも速かったです！
あのっ、
もう一度勝負しませんか！？

text_block_list.name: アーモンドアイ
text_block_list.text:
はぁ……
ふー……
降参ですか？
やった、
わたしの勝ちっ！
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
ふー……
降参ですか？
やった、
わたしの勝ちっ！

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Still, you were amazing! That was the closest I've come to losing so far!
If you all really gave it your best... I bet you could get even faster!
Since we're already here~
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
流石でした！　
今までで一番危なかったです！
みなさんが本気を出したら……
もっともっと、
速くなりそうですね！
せっかくですし──

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: How about another round?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう一度、
勝負しませんかっ！？

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: …………………… (Super excited)
text_block_list.orig_text: ……………………（わくわくわくわくわくわくわくわく）

text_block_list.name: Monstresses
text_block_list.text:
(This is impossible...)
(I can't do this anymore!)
(No way.)
text_block_list.orig_text:
（ムリゲー……）
（もう無理っ！）
（無理。）

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Aww, that bunch didn't even last until nightfall.
...So, are we still doing this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーあ。
あいつら、
結局夜までもたなかったわね。
……
で。
まだ続けるわけ？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
That monsterfolk rabble was but a prelude, a mere bit of sport.
The true spectacle begins now.
With the villains I held in check finally set loose, the iron chariot shall begin its advance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
先の鬼事、
前座の戯れ。
真に面白うなるは此処から。
繋ぎし悪党放たれしなれば、
鉄の車、
進め出でなんし。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Huh? We're still not done here?
By iron chariot you mean...
text_block_list.orig_text:
は？　
まだやんの？
鉄の車って──

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text:
...I've waited long enough.
It's time for the Bandy Shark to make its grand entrance!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──待ちくたびれた。
『バンディシャーク号』の出番だねェ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
WHAT THE?! "BANDY SISTERS"!!
YOU ALMOST HIT ME!
I'M GONNA KILL YOU!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとー！？　
【バンディ・シスターズ】！！
もう少しで当たるとこだったじゃない！
ぶっ殺すわよ！？

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text:
Your own damn fault for standing around like that.
You're practically asking to get run over!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなとこに突っ立ってんだ、
轢いてほしいと言ってるようなもんじゃないかい？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
LIKE HELL I AM!
I'm seriously gonna kill you!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
んなわけあるかー！
ほんとにぶっ殺すぞー！？

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
C-Calm down, Kyaru-chan.
...Acquaintances of yours?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
落ち着いてキャルちゃん。
……知り合い？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
"Acquaintances" doesn't even begin to cover it!
You see, the idiots inside that ridiculously huge armored vehicle are...
text_block_list.orig_text:
知り合いなんてもんじゃないわ！
あのバカでかい装甲車に乗ってるのはね──

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Now, now. Just because we're thieves doesn't mean we lack manners.
text_block_list.orig_text: 盗賊だからって礼儀知らずだと思われちゃ困るねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
The youngest sister of the guild "Bandy Sisters"!
I'm Fubuki☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
ギルド【バンディ・シスターズ】の三女！
フブキでぇーす☆

text_block_list.name: Wakana
text_block_list.text: I-I'm Wakana, the middle sister...
text_block_list.orig_text:
じ、
次女のワカナです……

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Which leaves me, the eldest sister, Yamato!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもってアタシが、
長女のヤマトってわけだ！

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text:
I hear they'll "knock some time off" our sentence if we beat that little girl over there.
But that's just an added bonus as far as I'm concerned. Oh, this should be fun.
It's been a long time since I've had any excitement other than a glass of red wine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこの小娘を伸してやりゃ、
刑期を『値引き』してくれるってハナシだが、
そんなのはただのオマケ。
ああ、
楽しみだねぇ。
ブドウ朱以外の『刺激』は久しぶりだよ。

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text:
As it happens, I'm the type who absolutely hates losing.
My "bad luck" against your "stubborn determination"...
Why don't we go all-in and see which one comes out on top? Haha!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいにくと
アタシも負けるのは大っ嫌いなタチでねぇ。
アタシの『悪運』とアンタの『意地』、
どっちが上か、
お互い全ツッパといこうじゃないか。
ハハッ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Nephy Nella, did you actually summon them here on purpose?
Those three bandit sisters who are out on parole?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ネフィ＝ネラ、
あんたわざわざ呼び寄せたの？
仮釈放中の盗賊三姉妹を？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
An amusing little diversion, would you not agree?
And if one were to take a peek at the spirited heart of dear Lady Ai...
Well, it certainly seems as though she is not entirely averse to it~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
興の沸く、
戯れでありんしょう？
まして其のアイ殿の弾む御心、
覗き見れば
満更でもなき色の浮かびて、
お見受けいたし候が──♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: …………………… (Excited)

text_block_list.name: キャル
text_block_list.text:
………まぁ。
いざとなったらあたしもいるわけだし。
text_block_list.orig_text:
………まぁ。
いざとなったらあたしもいるわけだし。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Ai! That thing's just big, that's all!
Go out there and leave them in the dust, just like before!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アイ！　
あんなのデカイだけの相手よ！
今度もぶっちぎりで勝っちゃいなさいよね！

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Leave it to me!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──任せて！

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'll win!
text_block_list.orig_text: わたしが勝つ！

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text:
She certainly has the legs to back up her bravado. But...
I'm not letting her get away.
text_block_list.orig_text:
言うだけあってイイ脚だねぇ。
でも
──逃がさないよ。

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Fubuki! Catch her with your "Hand"!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
フブキ！
『ハンド』で捕まえな！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Right on it, Sis Yama♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～い
ヤマ姉♡

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
SO HUGE!?
What's with that arm!? Ai! It's coming!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でかっ！？　
なにあのアーム！？
アイ！　
来るわよー！！

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Heh...!

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Wow, she's dodging so easily!?
Ai doesn't even look like she's breaking a sweat!
Doesn't this mean this race is as good as over?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
避けるのうまっ！？
アイのやつ余裕そうじゃない！
これってもう
勝負ありなんじゃないの！？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Korokorokorokoro...♪
Well now, I wonder what twists and turns await us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
コロコロコロ……♪
はて扨其れは、
如何なる仕儀に、
相成りましょうや。

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: FUBUKI!
text_block_list.orig_text: フブキ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
WHAAAAA?! What's with that cannon?!
That weapon's definitely against the rules!
Foul play!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁあ～～～！？　
なにその大砲！？
流石にその武器は反則よ！！　
反則負けよっ！！

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text:
What's the big deal, I'm not planning to hit her.
There's more than one way to take someone down, you know.
...FIRE!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぁに、
当てやしないよ。
仕留める方法は一つじゃないってね。
──撃ちな！！

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
W-What... is this...?
Why am I suddenly... losing consciousness...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
に……？
急に、
意識が……？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
That's sleeping gas! Get away!
Move further off...
GET OUT OF THERE!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それ眠りガスよ！！
離れて！　
もっと遠くへ──
外へ出なさい！！

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text:
Too late for that.
Fubuki, catch her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今更だねぇ。
フブキ、
捕まえな！

text_block_list.name: アーモンドアイ
text_block_list.text:
眠い、
──けど！
text_block_list.orig_text:
眠い、
──けど！

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I WON'T LOSEEEEEEEE!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 負けないんだからぁあああ～～～～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah...! A wall...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ、
はぁっ、
はぁっ……！
──壁……っ？

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's a dead end. We've led you right into our trap.
A sheer cliff with nowhere to go. You're a rat caught in a trap, as they say.
So, what now?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう、
行き止まりさ。
まんまと誘導されちまって。
まさに断崖絶壁。
袋のネズミとやらだ。
どうする？

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...A dead end.
However... that only means there's no way forward.
There are still other paths...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……行き止まり。
でも。
前にないだけで、
道はまだ
あるわ……

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text:
Ah, now that's the spirit...
You two, come over here.
Take careful aim.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ああ、
そりゃいい……
お前たち、
こっちへ来るよ。
しっかり狙っておやり。

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: CATCH HER!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 捕まえてやりなっ！！

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──はぁあああぁああっ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
By the time Kyaru finally found Almond Eye and the others, the agreed-upon nightfall was long past.
Their location far away from the Colosseum where it all started.
text_block_list.orig_text:
キャルがコロッセオを飛び出したアーモンドアイたちを発見したのは、
約束の夜はとうに過ぎた頃だった。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I finally found you all!!
text_block_list.orig_text: や～～～～～っと見つけた！！

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: ...The one you're looking for is right there.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……アンタの捜し物はそこだよ。

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (Zzz... Zzz...)
text_block_list.orig_text: （スー……スー……）

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
...She's just sleeping.
Doesn't look like she's hurt, at least.
So? How'd the match go?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……寝てるだけで、
怪我はないみたいね。
んで？　
勝負はどうなったわけ？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: W-What...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なによ……？

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: To think she actually leapt right over [rub:That Hunk of Junk]the Bandy Shark[/rub] to escape... She surprised us. I'd pay a pretty penny to have someone with that kind of guts on my side, then again...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか
『[rub:デカブツ]バンディシャーク号[/rub]』の真上を踏み越えていくとはね。
あの度胸、
高値で買ってやりたいところだが──

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text:
The "Hand" is busted, the cannon's chamber is empty...
My bottle of red wine has also run dry.
I'm afraid we've taken quite a beating here, so we're calling it quits.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ハンドは壊れて、
弾も空。
ついでにブドウ朱のビンも空っぽさ。
あいにくとこっちは大損中でね。
ここで降りさせてもらうよ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
So that means... it's Ai's victory?!
Well? Isn't that obvious~?
Still, I'm surprised you gave up so easily. That's not like you at all~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってことは、
アイの勝ち！？　
まぁ？　
当然よねぇ～？
でもさ、
あんたがこーんなあっさり音を上げるなんて、
意外よね～？

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text:
After seeing those "eyes" of hers...
Even I know better than to keep fighting a battle I've already lost.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんな『目』を見ちまえばねぇ。
流石のアタシも、
負けしかない勝負はごめんさ。

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haa... Fuu...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
ふぅ……
っ……

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Well now. Even after being hit by all those sleep rounds, you're still conscious?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おや。
あれだけ眠り弾を浴びておきながら、
まだ意識があるのかい？

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I won...
It'd be a waste... if I fell asleep here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふー……
勝ったのに……
……眠ったら……
もったいないので……

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text:
You won? I wonder about that.
The sun doesn't get to decide when "night" begins.
That's for me, standing right here, to decide.
text_block_list.orig_text:
勝った？　
それはどうだろうね。
『夜』がいつ始まるかなんて、
お天道様が決めることじゃない。
今ここに立つアタシが決めることさ。

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text:
Leave the result unsettled, and we go into overtime.
Bet everything on the next stroke of luck...
Not a bad gamble, is it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うやむやにしちまえば延長戦。
次のツキに全ツッパ……
悪くない博打だろ？

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
So, unless you acknowledge my victory...
I can't win...?
Well, that sounds exciting...
text_block_list.orig_text:
貴方が認めないと……
わたし、
勝てないって
ことですか……？
そうなら、
ワクワクしますね……

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: What was that?
text_block_list.orig_text: なんだって？

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You don't see...?
Until you're finally satisfied...
I'll keep going, over and over...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうでしょう……？
貴方が納得するまで、
ずっと
ずっと……

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
To think we could keep competing forever...
I have so much to look forward to...
Don't you agree? Hehe...
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ずぅーっと、
勝負できるなんて……
これから
楽しみ、
ですね……？　
ふふっ……

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text:
Tactics are useless against her.
She doesn't try to read luck or the flow of a match.
She just flips the entire board over by sheer force.
text_block_list.orig_text:
駆け引きなんて通用しない。
ツキや流れも読みやしない。
ただ力ずくで盤をひっくり返しちまう。

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text:
Every once in a while, you run into a monster whose depths you simply can't fathom.
With someone like that, it's far more entertaining to sit back and watch from the best seat in the house than to take them on headfirst.
text_block_list.orig_text:
たまに出会っちまうもんだ、
底の見えないバケモンに。
そういう手合いは真正面から相手にするより、
特等席で高みの見物と洒落込む方がずっと楽しいもんさ。

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: From here on out... I'll sit back and enjoy the show, with your grit and fighting spirit as the perfect accompaniment to my red wine. Kahaha!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっから先は……
アンタの根性と負けん気を、
ブドウ朱の肴にして見物させてもらうよ。
カッカッカ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Being "strong" means more than simply possessing power...
This outcome sent shockwaves through Geo-Gehenna, a world governed by the law of the jungle.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『強者』とは力だけに非ず──
この結末は、
弱肉強食の世界『ジオ・ゲヘナ』を騒然とさせた。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Little did Almond Eye know that, in time, the demonfolk would come to fear her as the "Monster's Bane".
The girl who drove anyone pursuing her to chase her all the way into the depths of a bottomless hell.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やがてその名は、
追う者を底なき地獄まで追わせる『鬼泣かし』として
妖魔人たちに恐れられていくことを、
彼女はまだ知らない──

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Zzz... It's my... win♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
わたしの、
かち♪
